name: Munch
ingredients:
Sugar, Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Hydrogenated vegetable fats, Fractionated vegetable fats, Milk solids, Cocoa solids (3.8%), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin and 476), Raising agent (500 (ii)), Yeast, Iodised salt, Flour treatment agent (516), Artificial (Vanilla) flavouring substances.
Allergen Note: Contains Wheat, Soy, Sesame and Milk. May Contains Nut.
